organizations.normalization_notes: The official award citation supplies the division, regiment, battalion and company. The division is the canonical organization; the subordinate unit is preserved in the role and evidence fields.
The obituary prints Renwar Oil Corp.; the dated discovery biography prints Ren-War Oil Corporation. Historical forms remain visible and are not replaced with a successor name.
The historical employer is preserved rather than replaced by a modern successor organization.

affiliations.role_title: Captain; commander, Company G, 2d Battalion, 16th Infantry Regiment
affiliations.date_precision: The award citation places Dawson with the division on August 28, 1944. A discovery-only biography says his Company G command ended after the October 1944 Aachen fighting and that he was reassigned to OSS after hospitalization; the exact transfer date requires personnel-file confirmation.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private-identifier match confirms identity. The division assignment is direct award evidence; its status as the immediate OSS predecessor is probable rather than explicit because the transfer chronology depends on a discovery-only biography.

affiliations.date_precision: The dated discovery biography says the Ren-War role began in 1938 and that Dawson enlisted in May 1941. The newspaper obituary independently confirms employment by Renwar Oil and enlistment in 1941, but the exact end day is not established.
affiliations.research_notes: This is the best-supported last civilian employer before Army service, not the immediate predecessor to OSS. Medium confidence reflects reliance on a discovery-only source for the 1938 start and sequence; the Box 173 file should confirm it.

affiliations.date_precision: The newspaper obituary confirms employment by Humble Oil. The discovery-only biography places this role before the 1938 move to Ren-War, but supplies no exact start date.
affiliations.research_notes: Published only as an earlier qualified role, not as the last civilian employer or immediate OSS predecessor.
